description: Token-efficient React & TypeScript code review
---
Review the selected React/TypeScript code against project conventions:
1. Identify type safety gaps, missing runtime configs (`runtimeenv.ts`), or schema validation misses (`src/schemas/`).
2. Highlight performance bottlenecks (unnecessary re-renders, missing memoization).
3. Provide concise, refactored code snippets with bullet-point notes only.
